h:head.h:title: Integrated Child Health and AMR Household Survey 2026

text.value: No competent adult after three visits
Card, card copy, or electronic record seen
Select from the list. Do not type the name.
List is filtered to the LGA you just selected.
Type a few letters to search. List has 2,524 entries -- do not scroll.
Filtered to the ward you just selected, and sourced directly from settlements.csv in the reference media -- record and code come from the same register the ministry supplied, not a re-typed list.
1.05 Is the settlement known locally by a different name?
Ask the respondent, do not assume from the register name alone.
If yes, write the name used locally.
Enter 1-999 (three digit box on the paper form).
1.06 Structure number painted on the dwelling
Copy the number exactly as painted. If none is painted, ask your supervisor before proceeding.
Enter 1-999 (three digit box on the paper form).
1.07 Household serial number within the settlement
The running count of households visited in this settlement -- your first household here is 1, second is 2, and so on.
Select your own code from the staff list.
Filled in automatically from your enumerator code -- nothing to type here.
Date must fall within the fieldwork period printed on the form (1-30 June 2026).
Must fall within the fieldwork period, 1-30 June 2026.
Point falls outside the Bansara state working area. Re-take the reading.
1.11 GPS reading at the entrance to the dwelling
Stand at the entrance to the dwelling and wait for the accuracy reading to settle before capturing.
A poor or indoor fix can be several hundred metres off. If the accuracy shown is worse than about 15m, step outside and try again before accepting the reading.
1.12 Was this household visited during the October 2025 round?
Format must be BAN-000000 and must match an identifier in the previous round register.
1.13 Household identifier allocated in the October 2025 round
Format BAN-000000, copied from the previous round's paperwork or supervisor list.
Previous round recorded child(ren) under five in this household. Confirm this is still plausible once the roster is complete.
If the result is anything other than Completed, sign at 7.03 and submit -- do not continue to later sections.
Result of visit means no further section is completed. Sign at 7.03 and submit.
2.01 Consent statement read aloud to the respondent in full?
Read the printed consent script exactly as written. Do not summarise or paraphrase it.
2.02 Does the respondent consent to the household interview?
If refused, thank the respondent, sign at 7.03, and submit -- no further section is completed.
2.03 Relationship of the respondent to the head of household
Consent was refused. Do not continue. Sign at 7.03 and submit.
Enter 1-30. If genuinely larger, flag for supervisor at 7.02.
3.01 How many people usually live in this household?
Ask this before listing the roster below. A usual resident is someone who normally sleeps here, even if temporarily away.
List every usual resident, beginning with the head of household. For a resident under five, record age in completed MONTHS. For everyone else, record age in completed YEARS.
Initials are acceptable and preferred where a full name is not needed for the interview.
Is this person under five years old?
Not on the paper form -- added so the digital form routes to column (5) or (6) correctly. See defects report D-02.
Completed years -- round down, do not round up to the nearest birthday.
(6) Age in completed months (under five only)
If exact age is not known, estimate using a local events/seasonal calendar rather than guessing.

This is computed automatically from the age just recorded -- it replaces the paper form's column (7), which was marked 'office use' yet was required live in the field to route question 3.02 (see defects report D-01).
4.02 Name or initials of the child (copied from roster)
4.03 Age of the child in completed months (copied from roster)
4.04 Sex of the child (copied from roster)
Paper question 4.05 asked for the weight itself, with 99 meaning not measured. Here that is two separate fields -- pick the status first.
Record to the nearest 0.1 kg, with the child in light clothing.
Paper question 4.06 asked for the measurement itself, with 99 meaning not measured. Here that is two separate fields -- pick the status first.
4.07 Position in which the child was measured
A change part-way through the round is expected -- record what was actually used, do not force consistency with earlier children.

WHO/DHS convention: measure children under 24 months recumbent (lying down); measure children 24 months and older standing, unless the child cannot stand, in which case use recumbent and note it at 7.02.
4.06 Length or height of the child (cm)
4.08 May I see the child's vaccination card or health record?
Ask to see the actual card or electronic record before answering -- do not accept a verbal description as 'seen.'
4.09 Copy from the card: is a measles dose recorded?
Record exactly what is written on the card -- do not ask the caregiver to recall this one, the card is in front of you.
4.10 Has this child ever received a measles vaccination?
4.11 Has this child had diarrhoea in the past 14 days?
Diarrhoea means three or more loose or watery stools in 24 hours.
4.12 Has this child taken any antibiotic medicine in the past 30 days?
If more than one was taken, record the most recent. NOTE: this list is a placeholder -- see the info icon.

PLACEHOLDER LIST -- the data pack supplied for this assessment did not include the ministry's medicine/antimicrobial code list referenced by the paper form at 4.13. The 13 medicine names below are a real, illustrative WHO AWaRe-informed list of common oral/injectable antibiotics (not invented drug names), but this is not the ministry's approved formulary code list and must be replaced with it before deployment -- see defects report D-05. The disclosure is kept here, at the field level, rather than repeated on every choice option, so the running form stays legible during testing.
4.14 If Other, write the name of the medicine as reported
4.15 Was the medicine obtained without a prescription from a health worker?
4.16 Was a photograph of the medicine packaging taken?
Ask the caregiver's permission before photographing the packaging.
Take a clear, well-lit photo showing the medicine name on the packaging.
5.02 Was a stool specimen obtained from this child?
If Yes, you will label and store it next. If No, you will record why below.
Label must be format BSN######-C, in your team's allocated range, with a valid check digit, and not already used for another child in this same household submission.
5.03 Specimen label number (affix label, then transcribe in full)
Affix the label to the specimen container first, then type the full code exactly as printed, including the letter/digit after the dash.

Format BSN######-C. The last character (a digit or the letter X) is a check digit computed from the six digits before it -- the form verifies it automatically and will reject a mistyped label, so re-check the physical label carefully before assuming the form is wrong.
5.04 Time the specimen was placed in the cold box
5.05 Temperature shown on the cold box thermometer
Read directly from the thermometer at the moment the specimen is placed inside.
Stated household size was . The roster you just completed lists people. Please recheck before continuing if these differ.
The source used most of the time, not an occasional backup source.
6.02 Kind of toilet facility usually used
6.03 Does this household keep poultry or livestock inside the compound?
6.04 Have any antibiotic medicines been given to these animals in the past 12 months?
6.05 Handwashing station with soap and water available?
Ask to see the handwashing place -- do not just ask the question and accept a verbal answer.
6.06 Has any member of this household had diarrhoea in the past two weeks?
'None of these' cannot be selected together with any other item.
6.07 Which of the following does this household own?
Select every item this household owns. Select 'None of these' only if none apply.
Interview end time is captured automatically when you submit; the form no longer asks you to type it separately (paper 7.01). See defects report and fabrication-detection doc.
7.02 Observation that may help the office interpret this form
Do not record the respondent's name or other identifying detail here -- see data-protection notes.
7.03 Enumerator signature (select your code again to confirm)
Supervisor review (completed after handover, not by the enumerator)
Babu babba mai iya bayar da amsa bayan ziyara uku
Gidan babu kowa ko an rushe shi
Mai kula ko yaro ya ki
An ga katin, kwafinsa, ko bayanin lantarki
An gani, akwai sabulu da ruwa
An fada kawai, ba a gani ba
Babu ko daya daga cikin wadannan
Zaba daga jerin. Kada a rubuta sunan da hannu.
Jerin ya dogara ne akan Kananan Hukumar da aka zaba.
Rubuta haruffa kadan don nema. Jerin yana da sunaye 2,524 -- kada a bi ta birgima.
1.05 Shin mutanen yankin na kiran wannan wuri da wani suna daban?
A tambayi wanda ake yi wa tambayoyi, kada a dogara da sunan da ke cikin rajista kadai.
Idan ee, rubuta sunan da ake amfani da shi a wurin.
1.06 Lambar da aka rubuta a gidan
Kwafi lambar daidai yadda take a rubuce. Idan babu lambar da aka rubuta, a tambayi mai kula kafin cigaba.
Adadin gidajen da aka ziyarta a wannan yankin -- gidan farko shine 1, na biyu 2, da sauransu.
Zaba lambar kanka daga jerin ma'aikata.
Ana cika wannan kai tsaye daga lambar ma'aikacinka -- babu abin da za a rubuta.
Dole ranar ta kasance cikin kwanakin fieldwork, 1-30 Yuni 2026.
Tsaya a kofar gida kuma jira har lambar daidaito ta zauna kafin dauka.
1.12 An ziyarci wannan gida a lokacin 2025 ba?
1.13 Lambar da aka bawa gida a 2025
Tsari BAN-000000, an kwafo daga takardun zagayen da ya gabata ko jerin mai kula.
An gaba an rubuta yara 'yan kasa da shekara biyar a wannan gida. Tabbatar hakan bayan kammala jerin gida.
Idan sakamakon ba An kammala ba, a sa hannu a 7.03 sannan a mika -- kada a ci gaba da sauran kashi.
Sakamakon ziyara na nufin ba za a ci gaba da wani kashi ba. Sa hannu a 7.03 sannan a mika.
2.01 An karanta bayanin yardar shiga gaba daya ga wanda ake tambaya?
A karanta rubutun yardar shiga daidai yadda yake, kada a takaita ko a canza kalmomi.
2.02 Wanda ake tambaya ya yarda a yi hira da gidan?
Idan an ki, a gode wa wanda ake tambaya, a sa hannu a 7.03, sannan a mika -- babu wani kashi da za a ci gaba da shi.
2.03 Dangantakar wanda ake tambaya da shugaban gida
An ki amincewa. Kar a ci gaba. Sa hannu a 7.03 sannan a mika.
3.01 Mutane nawa suke zaune a wannan gida?
A tambayi wannan kafin jera mutane a kasa. Mutumin da yake zaune yana nufin wanda yake barci a nan a saba, ko da yake ba ya nan yanzu na dan lokaci.
Ka lissafa duk wanda ke zaune a gida, farawa da shugaban gida. Ga wanda ke kasa da shekara biyar, rubuta shekarunsa da watanni. Ga sauran, rubuta da shekaru.
Ana iya amfani da gajerun haruffa maimakon cikakken suna idan ba a bukata a cikin hira.
Wannan mutum yana kasa da shekara biyar?
[HAUSA: sai an fassara ta kwararre — professional translation pending]
Shekaru cikakku -- a rage zuwa kasa, kada a kara zuwa ranar haihuwa mai zuwa.
(6) Watanni cikakku (kasa da shekara biyar kadai)
Idan ba a san ainihin shekaru ba, a yi kiyasi ta amfani da abubuwan da suka faru a yankin ko lokutan shekara, kada a yi tsammani kawai.
[HAUSA: sai an fassara ta kwararre — professional translation pending]
4.03 Shekarun yaro da watanni (an dauko daga jeri)
[HAUSA: sai an fassara ta kwararre — professional translation pending]
A rubuta zuwa 0.1 kg mafi kusa, yaro na sanye da tufafi masu sauki.
[HAUSA: sai an fassara ta kwararre — professional translation pending]
Ana sa ran za a canza yayin zagayen -- a rubuta abin da aka yi amfani da shi na gaskiya, kada a tilasta daidaituwa da sauran yara.
A rubuta zuwa 0.1 cm mafi kusa.
4.08 Zan iya ganin katin allurar yaro ko bayanin lafiyarsa?
A nemi ganin ainihin katin ko bayanin lantarki kafin amsawa -- kada a karbi bayanin baki a matsayin an gani.
4.09 Daga kati: an rubuta an yi wa yaro allurar kyanda?
A rubuta daidai abin da ke rubuce a kati -- kada a tambayi mai kula game da wannan, kati na gabanka ne.
4.10 Yaro ya taba samun allurar kyanda?
4.11 Yaro ya sha gudawa cikin kwanaki 14 da suka wuce?
Gudawa yana nufin fitsi mai laushi ko ruwa sau uku ko fiye a cikin awa 24.
4.12 Yaro ya sha maganin rigakafin kwayoyin cuta cikin kwanaki 30 da suka wuce?
4.13 Wanne maganin rigakafi ne aka sha?
Idan an sha fiye da daya, a rubuta wanda aka sha kwanan nan. LURA: wannan jeri na dan lokaci ne kawai -- duba alamar bayani.
4.15 An sami maganin ba tare da takardar likita ba?
A nemi izinin mai kula kafin daukar hoton fakitin.
A dauki hoto mai haske da bayyanawa wanda ke nuna sunan maganin a fakitin.
Idan Ee, za a manna lambar sannan a adana samfurin. Idan A'a, za a rubuta dalili a kasa.
5.03 Lambar samfurin (a manne sannan a rubuta gaba daya)
A fara manna lambar akan akwatin samfurin, sannan a rubuta cikakkiyar lambar daidai yadda take a buga, har da harafi/lamba bayan dash din.
5.04 Lokacin da aka sa samfurin cikin akwatin sanyi
Agogon awa 24, misali 14:30 don karfe 2:30 na yamma.
A karanta kai tsaye daga thermometer a lokacin da aka sa samfurin a ciki.
5.06 Dalilin da ba a samu samfurin ba
[HAUSA: sai an fassara ta kwararre — professional translation pending]
Tushen da ake amfani da shi mafi yawan lokaci, ba wanda ake amfani da shi lokaci lokaci ba.
6.02 Irin bayan gida da ake amfani da shi
6.03 Gidan yana da kaji ko dabbobi a cikin gida?
6.04 An bawa dabbobin magungunan rigakafi cikin watanni 12 da suka wuce?
6.05 Akwai wurin wanke hannu da sabulu da ruwa?
A nemi ganin wurin wanke hannu -- kada kawai a tambaya a karbi amsa ta baki.
6.06 Wani a gida ya sha gudawa cikin makonni biyu da suka wuce?
6.07 Wanne daga cikin wadannan gidan yake da su?
A zaba duk abin da gidan yake da shi. A zaba 'Babu ko daya' idan babu wanda ya dace.
[HAUSA: sai an fassara ta kwararre — professional translation pending]
7.02 Bayani da zai taimaka wa ofis
Kada a rubuta sunan wanda ake tambaya ko wani bayani da zai bayyana shi a nan.
